name: SUNREIT
recent: Sunway REIT 于 2026 年 11 月 10 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利为 RM116.17mil，NPI 表现受酒店业务疲弱与零售增长相互抵消。同期 EPF 与 KWAP 多次申报持股变动，另有数项「OTHERS」公告。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利 RM116.17mil。
EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
risks: 季度净利按年下降，酒店业务表现疲弱。
主要机构股东 EPF 与 KWAP 的持股出现变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 RM213.764mil，按年增长 4.2%，按季下降 0.9%；净利为 RM112.315mil，按年下降 13.2%，按季下降 2.2%；净利率为 52.5%，低于上一季度的 53.2%。

recent_en: Sunway REIT released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 10 November 2026, with net profit of RM116.17mil as hotel weakness offset retail growth. EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests, alongside several 'OTHERS' announcements.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 with net profit of RM116.17mil.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between October and November.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit declined year-on-year amid weakness in the hotel segment.
Changes in shareholdings by major institutional shareholders EPF and KWAP.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM213.764mil, up 4.2% year-on-year and down 0.9% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM112.315mil, down 13.2% year-on-year and 2.2% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 52.5%, lower than 53.2% in the previous quarter.
